text:
alex.carroll: Starting handover for the night shift — quick access and coverage sanity check. Im primary handing to @maya.kim, @samir.patel will be secondary. Leaving a checklist below, call out any gaps now.

maya.kim: ack, ready to take primary. quick question: do I still need the temporary AWS role for the dedicated cluster? I think mine expired.

samir.patel: I can be secondary. I still have Grafana admin view, but not the write role for dashboards (we usually don't need it). PD escalation keys? confirm.

alex.carroll: PD: you should be on the "night-oncall" schedule — pd-bot should confirm. If you can't see the escalation key, @elaine.vasquez has the backup key and can rotate it. Grafana: dashboard read is enough for ops, but for runbook-driven mitigation you might need the alerting config link. AWS: you need the `redwood-oncall` role to assume into Dedicated nodes and the diagnostic account.

pd-bot: PagerDuty: maya.kim is primary for schedule `night-oncall` (2026-03-15 00:00 -> 2026-03-15 07:00 UTC). samir.patel is/was set as the secondary. If this is wrong, run: `https://redwood.pagerduty.com/schedules/night-oncall`

oncall-bot: Incident bridge: `https://meetings.redwood.com/bridge/ops-bridge` active if a high-sev alert fires. Use `!bridge join` to post your name.

elaine.vasquez: alex — I can rotate the PD key, but we should avoid unnecessary rotations. If maya can access PD REST keys, fine. For AWS, if role expired, request JIT via Okta; steps below.

alex.carroll: Good. Add a couple quick verification commands so you can triage immediately after handoff:

```bash
# PagerDuty check (open in browser or curl if you have API key)
open https://redwood.pagerduty.com/schedules/night-oncall

# AWS assume-role test
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-oncall --role-session-name oncall-test --duration-seconds 900
aws sts get-caller-identity

# Grafana: open alerts page
https://grafana.redwood.com/d/alerts/alerts-overview
```

maya.kim: tried the AWS command, got "AccessDenied: Not authorized to perform sts:AssumeRole". Ill open a JIT request in Okta now. tagging @elaine.vasquez.

elaine.vasquez: spotted. JIT request submitted and approved — you should get the Okta push. If it doesn't come through within 2 min, escalate to iam-ops channel.

samir.patel: PD keys verified in UI, I can ack pages if needed. Grafana: I can see alert history but not edit alert rules. That's fine for triage.

alex.carroll: Coverage gap noted: if both primary and secondary are on call but one loses AWS assume-role, we still have limited mitigation options (logs only). Action items:
- maya: confirm Okta JIT success (reply here)
- samir: keep PD escalation key nearby and verify you can trigger bridge
- elaine: hold PD backup key and be ready to rotate if we lose both keys

maya.kim: Okta push arrived, assumed role. `aws sts get-caller-identity` returns the expected account. Im in.

alex.carroll: lovely. quick runbook pointers for the shift (links):
- Incident runbook (triage checklist): https://docs.redwood.com/runbooks/incident-triage
- Grafana quick play: https://docs.redwood.com/runbooks/grafana-ops-play
- PD escalation guide: https://docs.redwood.com/runbooks/pagerduty-escalation

samir.patel: FYI: if you need to rotate a Grafana API key quickly for dashboards, follow the play in Grafana runbook — but avoid rotating unless we have a broken automated play.

alex.carroll: Also reminder about cross-region fallback policy for Dedicated: if us-west pool is saturated, route to eu-central fallback (can add from console if you have the role). Thats covered in the routing runbook.

maya.kim: One more ask: can someone confirm access to the customer-impact dashboard? Need to see affected customer list if an alert spikes.

samir.patel: I can see the customer-impact dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.com/d/customer-impact/main . If you can't, ask data-team for read access or use the incident-queries Slack app.

elaine.vasquez: noted. If an automated incident triggers PD and you need to escalate to SRE leads, follow the contact matrix in the runbook. Ive left the matrix in the ops-drive folder.

alex.carroll: Closing checklist:
- primary oncall (maya) confirmed PD and AWS access — DONE
- secondary (samir) PD verified, Grafana read — DONE
- backup key holder (elaine) briefed — DONE
- runbook links posted here — DONE
- bridge link available in oncall-bot message — DONE

maya.kim: thanks all, taking over now. ping me in thread if anything pops before 00:30. :thumbsup:

samir.patel: passing monitor to maya, standing by as secondary. :ok_hand:

oncall-bot: Handover recorded: primary=maya.kim, secondary=samir.patel, handoff_ts=4418000000

alex.carroll: thanks team — leaving the bridge open for 15 min for context handoff.

maya.kim: acknowledged and locking in.

(END)
